evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection polling in src/net.cpp and P2P functional tests.
rationale: Prevents busy loops in socket polling and avoids unrequested reads bypassing backpressure limits. As noted in commit a626b28980, select() can continuously report TCP urgent indications without consumable data, causing a busy loop in the polling loop, which this PR mitigates by disconnecting or ignoring exceptfds.
